subject: EOQ Runway Lockdown — Final stage confirmations & ledger check
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EOQ Runway Lockdown — Final stage confirmations & ledger check

Team —

We need a hard lock on the EOQ runway by EOD Thursday (48h). Please do the following by the timestamps below:

1) Stage hygiene: update HubSpot stage to COMMIT for any deals that have signed intent or verified PO by 17:00 PT Wed. Mark as LOST if the procurement signal is missing and legal/finance haven't received PO exposure.

2) Ledger confirmation: double-check committed ARR/TCV in the attached workbook (sheet: ledger_rollup). If you find a >10% delta vs HubSpot, flag it in the workbook comments and ping me directly.

3) Finance checks: Ben — run a quick recon of expected invoicing cadence for committed deals and flag any that require SLA/credit approvals.

Attachments: EOQ_Runway_Workbook_v2.xlsx (workbook with per-opportunity tabs), template: AtlasTech-PO-intent.pdf (PO intake stub).

Key asks and deadlines:
- Update stages: Wed 17:00 PT
- PO / signed intent capture: Wed 17:00 PT
- Final ledger sign-off: Thu 09:00 PT

I'll aggregate rollups Thu morning and send the final ledger to Finance for close. If you have blockers (legal redlines, procurement delays), add them in the "Blockers" tab in the workbook and @mention me.

Thanks — this is the last mile.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EOQ_Runway_Workbook_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EOQ Runway Lockdown — Final stage confirmations & ledger check

Rishi —

Quick updates from my side after a morning sweep:
- Atlasys (DEAL-3897): PO intent received (procurement email attached). I updated HubSpot to COMMIT and added the PO stub in the workbook. Expect final PO by Fri EOD — procurement sent their internal approval.
- VerdeHealth (DEAL-3862): procurement still evaluating (no PO). Marked as Negotiation for now; added notes asking AE to reconfirm cadence.
- GlobalFin (DEAL-3901): verbal OK from CFO, legal awaiting MSAs redline — set as Commit Pending.

I've left row-level comments in EOQ_Runway_Workbook_v2.xlsx where numbers changed (notably Atlasys ARR moved $150k up after billing cadence clarified). HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3897

Ben — can you confirm if the Atlasys increase changes our month-end invoice schedule?

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: AtlasTech-PO-intent.pdf (pdf)

- VerdeHealth (DEAL-3862): left in Negotiation; AE to reconfirm by EOD tomorrow or mark LOST.
